BLOODY MAY. DO YOU THINK SHE'S DEAD?
NO, LOOK. She's breathing. Heavens above, you've taken a dazzling lock on that stone. Are you hurt?
Stay back, please. I have nothing worth taking. Easy now, we aren't thieves.

I have nothing worth taking. Easy now, we aren't thieves. I'm Clara. This is my sister May. We run the Copper Kettle just down the lane. You're freezing, hurt, and that puppy needs warmth. Come with us. We'll clean your cut and get you hot broth.

Surely Lord Connor is far too gallant to bankrupt his friends. Though I do hope you have saved a waltz for me at Lady Ashbury's ball tomorrow evening, my lord. How could I possibly refuse the brightest star in London, Miss Bellere? I shall count the hours. [laughter]
Tell me you have something, Finch. Have you checked the coaching inns along the Great North Road? Every inn, parish, shelter,
Every inn, parish, shelter, and hiring office within 40 miles of Windham and House, my lord. It is as though the girl vanished into thin air the afternoon she left your
It is as though the girl vanished into thin air the afternoon she left your gates. She had no my Finch.
She had no my Finch. No character reference, no winter coat, nothing but a single silver coin my mother threw at her. A young woman cannot simply disappear without leaving a trace.

A young woman cannot simply disappear without leaving a trace. Without a reference, she could not enter service in any respectable house, my lord. That leaves only taverns, factories, or the workhouses, and none of the parish registers in London bear the name
the workhouses, and none of the parish registers in London bear the name Penelope. [sighs] Double your search. Expand it to every market town and

Double your search. Expand it to every market town and roadside tavern between here and the coast. Question every coachman, every peddler, every stable hand. Money is no object. Just find her. I shall ride out at first light, my

Table four is asking for another picture of cider, Pen. An old miller wants to know if you've baked anymore of those spiced honey cakes. [laughter] Tell Mr. Miller he must finish his stew
Tell Mr. Miller he must finish his stew before I let him near the pastry table. Look at you, bossing the regulars around like you've owned this place since birth.

bossing the regulars around like you've owned this place since birth. When Clara and I dragged you out of the mud three months back, I didn't think you'd say two words to a soul. You and Clara gave me a roof when I had
You and Clara gave me a roof when I had nothing, May. You didn't ask for a character reference or judge my past. I owe you both my life.
or judge my past. I owe you both my life. Nonsense. You've single-handedly doubled our supper job with your cooking, and you keep the ledger straighter than our late father ever did.
you keep the ledger straighter than our late father ever did. Your family now, Pen. Welcome in from the chill, sir. Can I

Welcome in from the chill, sir. Can I hit you a bowl of mutton stew? Aye, bless you, miss. Terrible damp road coming out from Mayfair Whole city's in an uproar over the London season, though. Keeps the coachmen talking. Oh.
coachmen talking. Oh. What has the nobility in such a state? [gasps] Same thing every year, miss. Husband hunting. Though this season,
hunting. Though this season, all the bloodthirsty mamas in London are practically tearing each other's feathers out over the Duke of Wyndham or his younger brother.
Lord Connor, they call him.
Most eligible bachelor in the realm, apparently. Rich, handsome as sick, and a proper rack if you ask me.
handsome as sick, and a proper rack if you ask me. Charming every debutante in Mayfair, dancing until dawn and breaking hearts left and right without a care in the world.
Lord Connor, surely you have not forgotten you're to partner my Cordelia in the country dance. She has been practicing her steps all week simply for the honor.
dance. She has been practicing her steps all week simply for the honor. How could I forget, Lady Haverford? Though I fear my dance card is entirely full until supper. Pray forgive me.

Your youngest son is certainly enjoying the season, your Grace. Every eligible miss in Mayfair is throwing herself at his boots, although I suppose a charming rake is entitled to sow his wild oats before settling down. Connor possesses

rake is entitled to sow his wild oats before settling down. Connor possesses the Cavendish spirit, Lady Pembleton. Youthful high spirits are entirely natural for a gentleman of his station. In due time, he will choose a bride worthy of our bloodline.

In due time, he will choose a bride worthy of our bloodline. Thank heaven you intervened before his spirited nature led to a permanent stain on your house. My cousin's housekeeper heard whispers that a common scullery maid was turned

My cousin's housekeeper heard whispers that a common scullery maid was turned out from Windhamton House in disgrace last season, cast into the lanes without a character reference for forgetting her station in the gardens.
A minor domestic matter, Lady Pemberton. Servants who harbor delusions above their station must be dealt with swiftly. She has been thoroughly erased from our
She has been thoroughly erased from our household, and no one of consequence gives her a second thought.
Finch. Tell me you have not ridden back empty-handed. I rode through three market towns past the crossroads east of

empty-handed. I rode through three market towns past the crossroads east of the country estate, my lord, questioning every innkeeper and carrier along the post road. At a coaching inn near the river, an apothecary apprentice recalled treating a young woman matching your exact description three months ago. She had been pulled from the woods at dawn

exact description three months ago. She had been pulled from the woods at dawn after a storm, soaked, bruised from a fall, and carrying a stray pup inside her cloak. Where is she now? Is she safe? Clara and May took her in. They own a respectable roadside tavern called The

Clara and May took her in. They own a respectable roadside tavern called The Copper Kettle, roughly 20 miles south of the estate. She's been working there ever since. Your fee, Finch, doubled as promised,
Your fee, Finch, doubled as promised, and my eternal gratitude. Speak of this to no one, least of all my mother. My lips are sealed, my lord. Good luck to you.

Come now, my pretty little bird.
